The portable helpers schema-check their typed values, rerun inspection against the explicit document, and charge comparisons before testing complete field equality. They do not mint a prepared-document or permission proof.

`probe/src/main.rs` constructs its own two-language Parallel Article. Its Japanese and English branches share a Text node, display one image node twice, and contain a second distinct node with the same asset. Expected requirements are exactly Link 10, Link 11, Asset 12, Asset 13. All variants participate; repeated display of a shared image does not duplicate a requirement, while distinct equal assets remain separate. An unresolved reference only in the English variant and a second display path to an Anchor both fail label validation. A deliberately unresolved asset and `javascript:noop()` are enumerated unchanged: that is discovery behavior, not an assertion that the URI is safe to render.

Source-less zero Work/Allocation/Nodes/Depth/Output and Cancelled cases preserve the exact sticky reason and the borrowed document. A Work sweep includes both exact successes and WorkLimit results with usage at or below each cap.

`probe/src/bin/source.rs` uses its own CRLF/Unicode Article source through the real four-language compiler/profile, ParseSession, reader and Doc lower API. The fixed input contains Code `Math root 0 9`, a page link, InlineMath `Math frac 2 0`, and an image. The retained guest root kinds are Form:Root and Form:Frac; discovery does not evaluate the invalid degree or division expression. The Link cover starts at the original `link` bytes. Independent document and guest domain-hash computations agree with the plan. An empty first receiver preserves owner Doc nodes, Origins and Views, and re-encodes to identical canonical document CBOR. Both native inspection and receiver decode/reinspection admit the identity-distinct declared source bytes once.

Fresh Source/Work/Allocation/Nodes/Depth/Output zero and Cancelled cases preserve the exact sticky reason and input. Caller depth 7 adds seven to the measured peak and restores current depth on return. Output zero can stop native inspection because identity computation actually produces canonical CBOR bytes; this is not an invented byte size for the typed requirements vector.

`runs.json` contains full commands, targets, working directories, exit codes and full-log hashes. The independent native and wasm32-wasip2 binaries each run both probes. Raw whole-DocumentSyntax equality across first receiver is intentionally not asserted for guest canonical coordinates; owner fields and canonical bytes are compared as required by the existing contract.
